rules.instruction: Use bpmn:sendTask or bpmn:receiveTask when sending or waiting for a message is itself the modeled unit of work.

rules.instruction: When the description makes a follow-up action depend on whether a waiting period exceeds a stated duration: model the duration check with an exclusive gateway after the wait, route the conditional action along its applicable branch, and merge the paths before their shared continuation

rules.instruction: When the description says that items are processed iteratively, that overall completion is checked after an item is processed, and that an incomplete result leads to selecting another item and repeating the item-level check: Model the item-processing outcomes to converge before the overall completion check, and route the incomplete outcome through the next-item selection back to the item-level check.
rules.situation: the description says that items are processed iteratively, that overall completion is checked after an item is processed, and that an incomplete result leads to selecting another item and repeating the item-level check

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity with explicit alternatives or qualifiers that distinguish its scope: Label the corresponding BPMN element concisely while preserving those stated distinctions; do not generalize them away.

rules.instruction: When the description gives a process title but states no explicit start trigger: Label the start event with a concise form of the process title rather than a generic label.
